newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Oil&Gas March qtr sales NZ$3.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: NZ Oil&Gas March qtr sales NZ$3.1 mln.

text.p: New Zealand Oil and Gas on Tuesday reported sales receipts of NZ$3.1 million in the March 1997 quarter, along with production and development costs of $1.9 million and exploration costs of $0.7 million.
NZ Oil & Gas also advised that increased oil production from the Ngatoro field was achieved in the March quarter, with its share of 47,400 barrels up six percent on the December quarter.
NZ Oil and Gas said oil prices averaged US$23 a barrel for the period compared to US$24 a barrel in the December quarter.
"Ngatoro contributed $1.4 million to the group revenues for the March quarter (December 1996 quarter $1.3 million)," the company said.
"Production facilities are being upgraded to handle the increased production, and to replace rented equipment, thereby reducing operating costs."
Continued interpretation of the major "3D" seismic survey, which covered the entire Kupe Licence area, had identified a new prospect some 10 kilometres to the south of the Central Field Area.
"While further technical work is required to firm up this prospect for drilling, there are direct seismic indications of hydrocarbon entrapment within the prospect," NZ Oil and Gas said.
